description: A1/qou-78pt: measures the span of the Markov-normalisation convention family against the extensive-term deficit. The family is discrete and 1.33x wide; the deficit is 6-15x. No member reaches the target, so A1 is refuted rather than fitted.

span.verdict: span (1.33x) is two orders of magnitude smaller than the deficit (6-15x)

unreconciled.note: 6-8x apart; the ROAST does not show its construction and this probe does not reconstruct it. The span argument is a ratio and is unaffected either way.

data.verdict: A1 REFUTED, not unfitted. The ROAST called the option unfalsifiable because 'do not normalise' is a convention family and choosing the member that lands on a_V would be a fit. Measured, the family is DISCRETE (the two leading members differ by exactly one factor of q) and spans 1.33x, while the deficit is 6-15x. No member lands on a_V, so there is no fit available -- the option fails uniformly over the family. Pinning the convention from the axioms, which the ROAST called 'the actual work', is therefore not needed to dispose of A1.
